faq.q: Where do the sounds come from — are they audio files?
faq.a: No files are downloaded. Every sound is generated live in your browser with the Web Audio API. White, pink and brown noise come from procedural noise buffers, while rain, ocean, wind, fan, cafe, fireplace and binaural tones are built from filtered noise and oscillators. That is why it works offline and why nothing is uploaded.

faq.q: Why do the binaural tones need headphones?
faq.a: The binaural option plays 200 Hz in one ear and 210 Hz in the other, panned hard left and right, producing a 10 Hz beat only when each ear hears its own channel. Without stereo headphones the two tones mix in the air and the effect is lost. The tool itself notes binaural beats are not a medically proven treatment.

faq.q: What do the Pomodoro and sleep timer actually do to the audio?
faq.a: The sleep timer (15–90 minutes or a custom value) fades the mix out and stops it at a real clock deadline, so a background tab can't make it overrun. Pomodoro plays your mix during the focus minutes, fades it out during the break, replays a chime at each switch, then restores the exact same mix when focus resumes.

faq.q: Can I save a mix and move it to another device?
faq.a: Yes. Saved mixes are stored in your browser under amb_mixes, so they stay on that device. To carry one elsewhere use Export mix as JSON, which writes a file containing each slider level, the master volume and your saved mixes. The tool also logs listening sessions of a minute or more and can export them as a focus-sessions CSV.
